title: logo
universal_lens: The logo system formalizes a constrained state-space where brand identity is an invariant geometric manifold. Generative operators act as deterministic projections, preserving topological features (clear space, proportions) while strictly forbidding stochastic perturbations that violate the established Brand Lock constraints.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats the existing logo as a high-confidence prior distribution over visual geometry. Bayesian updates are restricted to explicit user directives; conformal prediction intervals tightly bound allowable variations, ensuring generated outputs maintain strict statistical fidelity to the original authoritative source files.
gse_mapping: In GSE, the workflow is a finite state machine. Transitions from 'concept-boards' to 'candidate generation' require explicit palette persistence. The engine enforces situational reasoning by vetoing any action that attempts to redraw locked assets, treating them as immutable boundary conditions.

primitives.name: Brand Lock Invariance Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Never ask an image model to redraw a logo merely to change its background, size, placement, or colorway.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L: Logo geometry (dimensionless vector space), T: Transformation operator (affine/scale).
primitives.assumptions: The underlying vector geometry of the logo remains perfectly preserved under standard affine transformations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the generative model is forced to rasterize and hallucinate new geometry instead of applying deterministic SVG/PPTX compositing.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to conservation laws in physics; the core identity manifold must remain invariant under environmental coordinate changes.
layer2.telemetry: Zero deviation in path coordinates between source file and final composite.

primitives.name: Partial System Extrapolation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Derive variants from source geometry rather than inventing a second style.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S: Source geometry set, V: Variant set, D: Deterministic derivation function.
primitives.assumptions: A complete brand system can be mathematically extrapolated from a minimal primary mark using consistent geometric rules.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when the source geometry is too ambiguous, leading to arbitrary stylistic inventions rather than rigorous derivations.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's conformal inference, generating valid out-of-distribution variants strictly bounded by the observed geometric priors.
layer2.telemetry: Geometric similarity score between derived variant and primary mark exceeds threshold.

primitives.name: Palette Gate Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: Require a user-selected and persisted palette before generating logo candidates.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: P: Color palette (RGB/CMYK vectors), G: Generation trigger (boolean).
primitives.assumptions: Color selection acts as a necessary precondition for the initialization of the geometric generation phase.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System enters an undefined state if auto-selection bypasses the explicit `approve_palette` handshake protocol.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE pre-computation gates; the state machine blocks transition to the candidate generation node until the palette tensor is fully resolved.
layer2.telemetry: Successful return of `approve_palette` state response before invocation of `PROPOSE_LOGO_MECHANISMS`.

reasoning_traces.think:
The logo system operates as a highly constrained optimization problem within a vast latent space of possible visual designs. The foundational axiom is the preservation of the 'Brand Lock,' which mathematically translates to enforcing strict invariance on the geometric manifold of an existing logo. When an official logo is supplied, it becomes the absolute ground truth. Any requested modifications—such as changing background, size, or placement—are treated not as generative tasks but as deterministic affine transformations applied via SVG or PPTX compositing. This prevents the stochastic noise inherent in diffusion models from corrupting the precise vector paths.

When dealing with partial systems, the engine shifts into an extrapolation regime. Here, the available primary mark serves as a sparse prior. The system must derive missing components (monochrome versions, clear space rules) through rigorous geometric analysis rather than stylistic invention. This requires identifying stable features, such as dominant stroke width or cap height, to define a repeatable unit 'x'.

Furthermore, the workflow introduces a hard temporal gate: the palette must be explicitly selected and persisted before any geometric candidates are generated. This decouples chromatic decisions from structural topology, reducing the dimensionality of the search space. The entire process is governed by a finite state machine that vetoes any attempt to merge distinct enhanced prompts or bypass the approval handshakes, ensuring that every output remains strictly collinear with the user's defined brand boundaries.

The current primitives digitize these analog constraints, translating physical clear-space rules into algorithmic bounding boxes and enforcing them via programmatic state transitions rather than human oversight. reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models two opposing agents: the user, who seeks expressive flexibility and novel applications, and the brand guardian, who demands absolute consistency. The engine acts as a mediator, anticipating the user's desire to 'redraw' a logo for aesthetic tweaks and preemptively vetoing it. It recognizes that true value lies not in random variation, but in the disciplined application of established geometric truths across new contexts.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity checks are paramount. If a generated candidate's geometric skeleton deviates beyond a calculated tolerance from the source vectors, the layer immediately triggers a veto. Similarly, leakage is prevented by ensuring that typography instructions do not bleed into logo-only requests. The system strictly isolates the chromatic layer (palette) from the geometric layer (mark generation) until the explicit gate condition is met, preventing premature convergence on suboptimal visual states.
